items.title: Birkhoff sections for geodesic flows on closed orientable Riemannian surfaces
items.difficulty_reason: The authors construct a finite nontrapping system of closed geodesics by combining flat-knot forcing, an innermost-contractible-geodesic argument and separate positive-genus/sphere cases. They then bound hitting times for the associated Birkhoff annuli and apply Fried’s cited surgery to obtain an embedded section. The complete source-local forcing and construction, together with author figures and the stated prior surgery, are preserved as proof dependencies, not hidden as background.

readability.basis: Existing 41-page reader from batch-14872-14875-r004; physically viewed pages 5, 35, 37 and 38 with original theorem, annulus construction and complete-system proof including author figure.

dedup.scope: Current master titles searched for Birkhoff section, geodesic flow and curve shortening; exact selected statements in 2513 and 2315 inspected.

compared.relation: Same work, selected Theorem 4.2 concerns C0 stability of visible length spectral values in primitive flat knot types. Theorem 4 asserts existence of a Birkhoff section for every closed orientable Riemannian surface and uses related forcing machinery.

Selected Proposition 5.3 constructs a boundary-strong Birkhoff section for a torus-invariant vector field on T²×I under given transverse-curve and homology assumptions; it does not assert sections for geodesic flows of arbitrary closed orientable Riemannian surfaces.

source_disclosures: Fried’s surgery is explicitly cited by the authors; no proof is supplied in its place. All nine existing original figure files remain referenced in the work record.
